description: Saint Patrick’s Day has always held a special meaning for my family. Over 130 years ago, my family’s Seattle story began when my great-grandmother, Lizzie Marshall, immigrated to Seattle from Ireland with her mother and two sisters, arriving the day before the Great Seattle Fire in 1889.
